description: Execute Shut Down through the canonical transaction spine and authoritative Native Adapter shutdown-status application.
planning_goal: Implement Shut Down end to end as the universal quick.shut-down action: keep Frame Conn authoritative for Quick Action commitment and exact committed-entry execution; show a plain Execute control for committed Shut Down without presenting it as a dice roll; resolve the authoritative acting actor through Native Adapter actor resolution; require the actor to not already have the native Lancer shutdown status; execute Shut Down through the canonical System Bridge -> Semantic Execution Context -> Execution Transaction -> Native Adapter spine; apply only the authoritative native shutdown status through the existing native status adapter and Actor.toggleStatusEffect pathway; do not create or mutate any duplicate Frame Conn shutdown state; treat already-active shutdown state or failed native mutation as execution failure so the committed entry remains pending; after native mutation succeeds, mark only that exact committed entry executed and refresh Frame Conn from authoritative actor and Turn state; preserve the existing centralized ownership of broader Shutdown consequences and action legality rather than duplicating those rules inside the action executor; correct stale documentation that incorrectly labels Shut Down as a Full Action when the canonical action is quick.shut-down; preserve all unrelated action behavior.
